top_findings.title: No README.md with setup/run instructions
top_findings.evidence: find -iname 'readme*' over run_dir returns nothing; only main.py, requirements.txt, tests/test_main.py exist. TASK.md Deliverables require 'A README.md with setup and run instructions'
top_findings.suggestion: Add a README.md documenting install (pip install -r requirements.txt) and run (uvicorn main:app) steps

top_findings.title: Fewer than 3 running tests: only 2 defined and both skipped
top_findings.evidence: tests/test_main.py defines exactly 2 test functions (test_health, test_crud); pytest final run reports '2 skipped, 6 warnings' with 'async def functions are not natively supported and have been skipped' — effective_tests=0; REQUIREMENTS.json R12 requires '>= 3 tests exist and run'
top_findings.suggestion: Add asyncio_mode=auto (pytest.ini/pyproject) so pytest-asyncio collects the async tests, and add a third test (e.g. 404 / validation-rejection case)
